entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Of course. It's easy to dwell in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. It's easy to dwell in the past, but it's the present that requires our attention."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Ah, the Battle of Holsord. A tragi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, the Battle of Holsord. A tragic moment in our history. I wasn't directly involved, but I saw its devastating effects."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I can still recall the sight of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can still recall the sight of the city in ruins, the people despairing. It was a stark reminder of the cost of war."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The Great Betrayal... It was a dar..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Great Betrayal... It was a dark time, and not only for the monarchists. The entire city was gripped by fear and suspicion."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But we pushed through. Despite the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we pushed through. Despite the upheaval, the work of rebuilding the capital couldn't be put on hold."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That's what they say. But in my op..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what they say. But in my opinion, their flaws outweighed their merits."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The Corps, for instance, establish..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Corps, for instance, established a sense of order that helped the populace recover, but its indoctrination methods were questionable."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""As for Sollonomics, it did help st..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for Sollonomics, it did help stabilize the economy, but it also led to a heavy centralization of power."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It wasn't easy. The USP had a cert..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wasn't easy. The USP had a certain way of doing things, and quite a few members saw my reforms as a threat."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But I believed in what I was doing..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I believed in what I was doing, and I was persistent. Eventually, I managed to win over the number of supporters I needed to overhaul the system."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Winning the leadership was a criti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Winning the leadership was a critical step towards implementing the reforms Sordland so desperately needed."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But we must remember the state the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we must remember the state the country was in when I took over. We were stagnant, and change was necessary."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Unfortunately, economic reforms of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, economic reforms often have unintended side effects."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Thank you, Mr. President. I tried..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. President. I tried my best to use my expertise to benefit the party and the country."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Yes, and that's something I regret.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, and that's something I regret."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The fresh sea breeze, the energy o..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fresh sea breeze, the energy of the city... it's always so invigorating. Makes you forget about the stuffy old bureaucrats trying to get in the way of your policies."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A little ironic, isn't it? You esc..."
entries.dialogueText: "A little ironic, isn't it? You escaped the bureaucrats, but by increasing Sordland's reliance on global trade and foreign powers, you traded one set of chains for another."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I wish I could escape like that. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could escape like that. But I never stop thinking about my duties in Holsord. Even now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I couldn't agree with you more. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't agree with you more. I really should get out of Holsord more often."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I always used to go here to escape..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always used to go here to escape the political pressure in Holsord."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Nothing like Holsord, is it?""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing like Holsord, is it?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I do miss the capital sometimes. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do miss the capital sometimes. I still remember arriving there fresh from Arcasia, brimming with enthusiasm and ideas."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I think it was that feeling that l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think it was that feeling that led me to enter the political sphere in the '40s. I could tell the country was stagnating, and I used my knowledge of free-market reforms to garner support within the USP."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""As an engineer, my focus was on th..."
entries.dialogueText: "As an engineer, my focus was on the energy infrastructure of Holsord. We had many blackouts back then. It was a challenging time -- the aftermath of the Civil War was still evident everywhere."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But even after winning the party l..."
entries.dialogueText: "But even after winning the party leadership against Soll, my time in office was a continuous struggle to dismantle old USP structures and bring about prosperity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked lost in thought for a mom..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked lost in thought for a moment. Then he continued.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alphonso seemed to retreat into his..."
entries.dialogueText: Alphonso seemed to retreat into his memories for a moment. A gust of wind rattled the helicopter as he continued.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Alphonso, your political caree..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Alphonso, your political career is well-known. Perhaps we should focus on the present?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Free-market reforms were a signifi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Free-market reforms were a significant departure. You couldn't expect the traditionalists in the USP to swallow them whole."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So your economic expertise was wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "So your economic expertise was what gave you the edge against Soll. Quite the feat, I must say."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You sound quite proud of your achi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You sound quite proud of your achievements. But what about the effects of your reforms on the common people? Didn't the wealth gap widen during your tenure?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You must have arrived shortly afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must have arrived shortly after the Battle of Holsord ended."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I understand that those were tumul..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that those were tumultuous times. The Great Betrayal was not so long in the past, was it?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The State Educators Corps and Soll..."
entries.dialogueText: "The State Educators Corps and Sollonomics also played significant roles in the rebuilding of Holsord, didn't they?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""A valid concern, {BaseGameText.Alp..."
entries.dialogueText: "A valid concern, {BaseGameText.AlphonsoToPlayer}. But in a globalizing world, complete isolation isn't a viable strategy."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That's no good, {BaseGameText.Alph..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's no good, {BaseGameText.AlphonsoToPlayer}. You can't make the right political decisions if you're never exposed to life outside the bubble."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It does you good, being exposed to..."
entries.dialogueText: "It does you good, being exposed to life outside the political bubble."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You know, looking at the sea remin..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know, looking at the sea reminds me of an incident from my early days at Gasom."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""For me, it shaped my political str..."
entries.dialogueText: "For me, it shaped my political strategies, making them more people-centric and grounded."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It reminded me of the potential of..."
entries.dialogueText: "It reminded me of the potential of Sordland, of what our nation could be if we embraced change and diversity as Lachaven has."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""We had a big deal with a client fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had a big deal with a client from Xina, but a gas tanker broke down mid-journey. The delivery was at risk. It was winter, the seas were rough."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""We had two days to get the gas to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had two days to get the gas to its destination or we'd lose the client. So, I chartered a small cargo ship, braved the stormy seas, and supervised the transfer of the containers myself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Wow. That story speaks volumes abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wow. That story speaks volumes about your dedication to Gasom."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your story is impressive, but shou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your story is impressive, but shouldn't Gasom have had contingency plans for such situations?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fascinating. But I hope those inci..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fascinating. But I hope those incidents aren't too frequent at Gasom."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The whole company is like that. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "The whole company is like that. We'll do whatever it takes for our clients."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Take a look, Mr. President. That's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take a look, Mr. President. That's the world out there in the Lachaven harbor."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""No, of course not. We had a good l..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, of course not. We had a good look at our risk management and strategic planning after that debacle."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You're right, and we learned that..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, and we learned that lesson the hard way. Since then, we've implemented extensive contingency plans."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Don't worry, {BaseGameText.Alphons..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry, {BaseGameText.AlphonsoToPlayer}. We've come a long way since then."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So Gasom's success hinged on your..."
entries.dialogueText: "So Gasom's success hinged on your personal heroics? That's not a sustainable strategy for a corporation, is it?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I remember when we were negotiatin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I remember when we were negotiating our first international contract. We had engineered new excavation methods, but they were untested, unknown. The other side had many alternatives. They could have chosen any established player, but they chose us, a Sordish company."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That deal put Gasom, and in turn S..."
entries.dialogueText: "That deal put Gasom, and in turn Sordland, on the global map. Now, we're a force to be reckoned with in the energy sector."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's not about rejecting Gasom, it..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not about rejecting Gasom, it's about evaluating the best for Sordland. Not all that glitters is gold, Alphonso."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That may be true. But only shootin..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be true. But only shooting stars break the mold."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You didn't just reject a business..."
entries.dialogueText: "You didn't just reject a business deal back at Gasom. You rejected a chance to further our nation's reach in the global market."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They're over-relying on a single s..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're over-relying on a single sector. It could leave them vulnerable in the long run."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Why, you ask? Because we were will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, you ask? Because we were willing to take risks for the greater reward."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I respect your perspective, Alphon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect your perspective, Alphonso. But not every risk guarantees a reward."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's obvious by now that our visio..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's obvious by now that our visions for Sordland differ. I believe in a diversified approach, not just relying on one sector or company."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You've built a successful business..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've built a successful business, Alphonso. But the state isn't a business. The risk is carried by our citizens, not shareholders."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I understand that, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that, Mr. President. But without risk, there's no innovation, no progress."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Diversification is wise, but so is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Diversification is wise, but so is recognizing and capitalizing on our strengths, of which energy is certainly one."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Their extensive offshore oil and g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their extensive offshore oil and gas operations and expansive trade relations are proof that their willingness to seize opportunities, even in the face of adversity, has paid off."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you suggesting we follow Anrak..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you suggesting we follow Anraka's model despite our vastly different histories and challenges?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That doesn't mean we can't apply s..."
entries.dialogueText: "That doesn't mean we can't apply successful business strategies for the benefit of our citizens."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Look at the Federation of Anrakan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at the Federation of Anrakan Isles. They've successfully leveraged their strengths in sea exploration, resource extraction, and naval technology, and turned their geography into an advantage. "

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But perhaps, Mr. President, you do..."
entries.dialogueText: "But perhaps, Mr. President, you don't share the same admiration for Anraka's strategy?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Which of their strategies do you s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which of their strategies do you suggest we adapt?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you willing to consider other..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you willing to consider other sectors for investment, or is your focus solely on energy?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I'm not suggesting we copy Anraka'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not suggesting we copy Anraka's model verbatim, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Well, for one, their focus on offs..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, for one, their focus on offshore extraction and naval technology could be beneficial for us, given our lengthy coastline."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""While my focus is on energy, I am..."
entries.dialogueText: "While my focus is on energy, I am not blind to the potential of other sectors. But for now, I believe the energy sector holds the most promise for Sordland's economic growth."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Trust is earned, Mr. President. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust is earned, Mr. President. I hope to earn yours by showing you that I'm committed to Sordland's growth. As for my priorities, I believe business can be a force for good."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My actions are always guided by my..."
entries.dialogueText: "My actions are always guided by my commitment to the Sordish people, not personal gain."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I don't think so. Their diversific..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think so. Their diversification within the energy sector and strong international trade network will help mitigate that risk."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I'm only saying that we have much..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm only saying that we have much to learn from them."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Also, their willingness to foster..."
entries.dialogueText: "Also, their willingness to foster strong international trade relations is something we could definitely emulate."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you ever worry that your focus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you ever worry that your focus on profit might come at the expense of the Sordish people?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your dealings have been under scru..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your dealings have been under scrutiny before, Alphonso. Can you assure me that your interest in the energy sector isn't self-serving?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why should I trust you, Alphonso,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why should I trust you, Alphonso, when you've been known to prioritize business over everything else?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Every decision I've made was in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Every decision I've made was in the best interest of Sordland and its citizens."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Of course it's self-serving, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course it's self-serving, Mr. President. I'm a businessman, not a saint. But I also firmly believe that what's good for Gasom is good for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Mr. President, I understand the im..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I understand the implications of my decisions. I won't pretend I'm not interested in profit, but I firmly believe that a prosperous Gasom means a prosperous Sordland."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""While we're on the topic of trust,..."
entries.dialogueText: "While we're on the topic of trust, Mr. President, may I remind you that quite a few of your own decisions have been met with controversy. How do you justify your own actions?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't need to justify my actions..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need to justify my actions to you, Mr. Alphonso. You are Sordland's past; I am its future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The helicopter tilted to the right..."
entries.dialogueText: The helicopter tilted to the right and re-adjusted its course. Serge, sensing the escalating tensions in the cabin, reluctantly interjected.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Mr. President, Mr. Alphonso, I may..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, Mr. Alphonso, I may only be a driver, but it seems to me that both of you want to steer Sordland towards a better future. You just disagree on the right road to get there."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Serge. It's good to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Serge. It's good to be reminded that we all share a common goal."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Serge, do you believe that our dut..."
entries.dialogueText: "Serge, do you believe that our duty to the Sordish people should be our guiding principle?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Serge, your perspective is refresh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Serge, your perspective is refreshing, but a bit naive. The world of politics and business isn't as straightforward as driving a car."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You know, Serge, if you ever find..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know, Serge, if you ever find yourself weary of the political circus, I could always use a reliable man like you at Gasom. Consider it an open offer."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""I appreciate the offer, Mr. Alphon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the offer, Mr. Alphonso, but serving President Rayne and Sordland is my duty and I am proud of it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Serge is loyal to his duty and to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Serge is loyal to his duty and to Sordland, Alphonso. I suggest you respect that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Serge, you don't need to answer th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Serge, you don't need to answer that. This is not the time or place."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Alphonso, I hope you're not trying..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alphonso, I hope you're not trying to poach my staff mid-flight!"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Of course, Mr. President. I meant..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Mr. President. I meant no disrespect."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I understand, Mr. President. It wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand, Mr. President. It was just an offer."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Apologies, Mr. President. I didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apologies, Mr. President. I didn't mean to overstep."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Just a friendly offer, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just a friendly offer, Mr. President, nothing more."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am glad to see you value Serge's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am glad to see you value Serge's skills, Alphonso. But I need him more than you do."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Serge, in your view, is it possibl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Serge, in your view, is it possible to balance business interests with a commitment to public service?"

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""That's very kind of you, Mr. Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very kind of you, Mr. President. I'm here to serve."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""I believe so, Mr. President. That'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe so, Mr. President. That's what service means to me."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Mr. President, I don't know much a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I don't know much about business, but I think it's possible if one's heart is in the right place."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Well said, Serge. I strive to bala..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well said, Serge. I strive to balance my business interests with my commitment to Sordland every day."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""And serve you do, Mr. Wolkner. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "And serve you do, Mr. Wolkner. You're as astute as you are competent."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""A fine sentiment, Serge. I agree t..."
entries.dialogueText: "A fine sentiment, Serge. I agree that the Sordish people should always come first."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I appreciate your support, Mr. Pre..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your support, Mr. President. It's reassuring to know that there are others who share my dream of a prosperous Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your reforms had quite a few criti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your reforms had quite a few critics, actually. Some said they directly caused the 1951 recession."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not sure any amount of reform..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure any amount of reform could have prevented the recession of '51. Do you think there's a surefire way to stop these crises?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's easy to pass judgement in ret..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's easy to pass judgement in retrospect, Mr. President. At the time, I believed those reforms were necessary for Sordland's economic progress."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your rapid privatization plan dest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your rapid privatization plan destabilized key sectors of our economy, leading to the worst recession in our modern history."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you think the economic downturn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think the economic downturn could have been avoided if the Old Guard hadn't obstructed your reforms?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You made your dislike of my polici..."
entries.dialogueText: "You made your dislike of my policies loud and clear when you stole the party leadership out from under me."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Flipping my supporters, snaking yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Flipping my supporters, snaking your way into my inner circle... I won't lie, it was a hard blow."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We did what we had to do to save t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We did what we had to do to save the party and the country. I hope you can understand that."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I understand why you intervened. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand why you intervened. I was struggling to maintain control."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Resentment doesn't do anyone any g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Resentment doesn't do anyone any good, Mr. President. What happened, happened."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""In the world of politics, we often..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the world of politics, we often find ourselves making tough choices for the greater good."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But I do admit they could have bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I do admit they could have been implemented at a more moderate pace."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I appreciate your candid feedback.""
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your candid feedback."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your honesty is appreciated, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your honesty is appreciated, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That's a fair critique, Mr. Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a fair critique, Mr. President. Change can be unsettling, especially when it challenges long-held beliefs."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""A valid perspective. Balancing eco..."
entries.dialogueText: "A valid perspective. Balancing economic growth with social safety is indeed a complex challenge."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Regardless of your motivations, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless of your motivations, your support during those times was crucial, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I understand your viewpoint, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand your viewpoint, Mr. President. I still believe my reforms were necessary, but I'll be the first to admit they weren't perfect."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I still see myself as a facilitato..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still see myself as a facilitator for change. Someone who can help Sordland navigate the complexities of the global economy."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The resistance from the Old Guard..."
entries.dialogueText: "The resistance from the Old Guard certainly worsened the situation, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Destabilization wasn't my goal. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Destabilization wasn't my goal. I was trying to attract foreign investment and stimulate competition."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you still resent me for the way..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you still resent me for the way things turned out?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I still believe I brought Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still believe I brought Sordland the change it needed. But I acknowledge that not everyone may share this view."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You're correct, Mr. President. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're correct, Mr. President. The recession was a complex event."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You were losing control, Alphonso...."
entries.dialogueText: "You were losing control, Alphonso. My intervention was necessary to steer the party in the right direction."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But addressing systemic corruption..."
entries.dialogueText: "But addressing systemic corruption, improving bureaucratic efficiency and ensuring transparent governance could be key to preventing further downturns."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""If the necessary reforms had been..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the necessary reforms had been implemented in a timely manner, we might have been able to avert the severity of the recession."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""However, I admit that the transiti..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I admit that the transition could have been better managed."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But I can't help but wonder if you..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I can't help but wonder if you could have achieved your goals in a less aggressive manner."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's the future of the country tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the future of the country that we need to focus on now."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Was that your motivation? I'm not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Was that your motivation? I'm not sure."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Their commitment to natural resour..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their commitment to natural resource extraction and emphasis on naval engineering are commendable. And as a neutral power, the country offers a counterweight to the battle between United Contana and Arcasia."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Gasom has multiple engineers hired..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gasom has multiple engineers hired from Anraka too. I believe Sordland could find a valuable partner in Anraka in the coming decade."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I see potential for collaboration,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see potential for collaboration, particularly in offshore resource extraction and marine conservation. We've got much to learn from them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm impressed as well, but it's cr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm impressed as well, but it's crucial we remain cautious. Anraka's history of piracy and stringent laws could pose challenges in a potential partnership."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should rather focus on Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should rather focus on Sordland's own strengths. Our future lies in building a self-reliant economy and bolstering our own industries."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Anraka has potential. But isn't Ru..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anraka has potential. But isn't Rumburg already a counterbalance to the United Contana-Arcasia power struggle?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Precisely, Mr. President. It's not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely, Mr. President. It's not just about the economic benefits."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your concern is valid, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your concern is valid, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Absolutely, Mr. President. Strengt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely, Mr. President. Strengthening our domestic economy is paramount."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Rumburg does indeed possess signif..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg does indeed possess significant power, Mr. President. But the Queen is far more opposed to United Contana and the CSP than Arcasia and the ATO."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Working together can drive innovat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Working together can drive innovation and sustainability for both nations."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""While Anraka has its unique comple..."
entries.dialogueText: "While Anraka has its unique complexities, I believe these challenges can be managed with careful diplomacy and mutual respect."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But partnerships with countries li..."
entries.dialogueText: "But partnerships with countries like Anraka -- or Rizia, for that matter -- could also serve to enhance our own capabilities."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The dynamics would need to shift s..."
entries.dialogueText: "The dynamics would need to shift significantly before they could serve the same function as Anraka."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""These are the kind of factors you..."
entries.dialogueText: "These are the kind of factors you need to take into account if you're going to reform the Energy Protection Act, by the way. It might seem minor, but any alteration could shape Sordland's future."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But over time, I realized that his..."
entries.dialogueText: "But over time, I realized that his approach wasn't working, and that a new direction was needed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You were part of the USP during So..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were part of the USP during Soll's rule. You supported his policies then. What changed?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you think the growth and prospe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think the growth and prosperity of Lachaven can be replicated in other parts of Sordland?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It took time for their vision to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "It took time for their vision to be realized. They didn't even see it come to full fruition during their lifetimes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Kingdom was a different era. D..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom was a different era. Do you think its strategies can be applied in our modern-day context?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You may be right. But not all citi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may be right. But not all cities have Lachaven's potential or resources."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It must have been interesting, nav..."
entries.dialogueText: "It must have been interesting, navigating all the changing political dynamics as an outsider."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You're correct, Mr. President. Yes..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're correct, Mr. President. Yes, I supported Soll's policies early on."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Honestly, the key lies in strategi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, the key lies in strategic planning and targeted investments. We need to identify sectors with high growth potential and channel our resources there."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Indeed, Mr. President. While the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Mr. President. While the context has changed, the principles of visionary leadership remain the same."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I believe that Lachaven's success..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe that Lachaven's success today is due to the collective effort of its people, not a deceased monarch."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""You're absolutely right, Mr. Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're absolutely right, Mr. President. Each city in Sordland has its own unique strengths and challenges. Our strategies must be tailored to leverage these unique attributes."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That's a great point, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a great point, Mr. President. The key lies in persistence and long-term planning."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But would their efforts have been..."
entries.dialogueText: "But would their efforts have been as strong without those leaders setting the direction?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It was a truly incredible experien..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a truly incredible experience, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Despite the challenges and hardshi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the challenges and hardships, there was a sense of purpose, a collective will to rebuild and forge ahead."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sounds like a momentous time to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds like a momentous time to be in Holsord. How did it feel to be part of the transformation of the city?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The dynamics in Holsord were... co..."
entries.dialogueText: "The dynamics in Holsord were... complicated, to say the least. It was hard not to get caught in the intricate web of political alliances and business rivalries."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It was a steep learning curve, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a steep learning curve, but it was also an invaluable lesson in understanding the complexities of Sordish politics."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alphonso seemed to retreat into his..."
entries.dialogueText: Alphonso seemed to retreat into his memories for a moment. A gust of wind rattled the helicopter as he continued.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Getting back to Lachaven... I was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Getting back to Lachaven... I was thinking about how the whole city displays the vision of King Egmund."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Without the investments that he an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without the investments that he and his chief architect made, Lachaven wouldn't stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Haelm, Porte Drazon, Konstantium and Falenco today."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You speak of escaping from old bur..."
entries.dialogueText: "You speak of escaping from old bureaucrats. But isn't the capitalist system you promoted just another form of bureaucracy? Possibly even the worst form of all, for those less fortunate."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""An interesting perspective, {BaseG..."
entries.dialogueText: "An interesting perspective, {BaseGameText.AlphonsoToPlayer}. Of course capitalism creates disparities."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But it's also an engine for growth..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it's also an engine for growth and innovation. The challenge, as I see it, is to create a more inclusive capitalism that serves the needs of all Sords."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""We need to carve out a path that a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to carve out a path that allows Sordland to benefit from our foreign relations while also maintaining our sovereignty."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I didn't campaign for you because..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't campaign for you because of your economic reforms, but because I wanted change by any means necessary."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""To be honest, I never agreed with..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, I never agreed with your economic reforms. I felt they disproportionately favored the wealthy and neglected the needs of the common people."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""To be frank, Mr. Alphonso, I didn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be frank, Mr. Alphonso, I didn't campaign for you because I didn't like the direction you were taking the party in. I too wanted change, but not your way."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can tell you now that I didn't s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can tell you now that I didn't support your campaign. I felt that the USP was moving away from its roots and that your free-market reforms were a departure from our values."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sure you remember that I campa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you remember that I campaigned for you. I believed in your economic vision then, just as I do now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Even when I was campaigning for yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even when I was campaigning for you, I had reservations about your economic platform. I thought there could have been a better balance between free-market principles and social safety nets."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Just as Lachaven's success is tied..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just as Lachaven's success is tied to its global connectivity, Sordland's wealth is tied to its connection to the world and its skilled, educated workforce."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's akin to what we're trying to..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's akin to what we're trying to achieve with Gasom. Success isn't built overnight. It's the cumulative result of years of planning, investments, and execution."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From here, it was even more evident..."
entries.dialogueText: From here, it was even more evident what a pivotal role the city of Lachaven played in our international trade. Here, at the so-called "Gateway", was where Sordland opened itself to the global market.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""We need to identify our strengths,..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to identify our strengths, understand our challenges, and formulate a strategy that leverages our unique advantages. It's about adapting and innovating, not merely replicating."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's not about a one-size-fits-all..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not about a one-size-fits-all approach, but a nuanced strategy that considers the local context."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""And of course, we need to create a..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, we need to create a business environment that encourages innovation and entrepreneurship."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The past may have laid the foundat..."
entries.dialogueText: "The past may have laid the foundation, but it's the present that builds upon it."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Looking at the global landscape, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looking at the global landscape, I see great potential in Anraka. Despite their turbulent history, they've emerged as a beacon of resilience and innovation."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It was disheartening, but there wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was disheartening, but there was still a sense in those times that anything was possible."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Still, what I remember most about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, what I remember most about those times was the sense that truly anything was possible."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Back in those days, there was the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Back in those days, there was the sense that truly anything was possible."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Before that, I had the sense that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before that, I had the sense that truly anything was possible."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""You're right, Mr. President. Pleas..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, Mr. President. Please excuse my interruption."
